overview.text: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed to Saturday for the first time in its history because of high winds from a storm.
A federal judge temporarily blocked the FCC from an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses, which the network calls punishment for speech.
Congress is scrutinizing Nvidia and Jensen Huang's reinstatement, while a CBS investigation finds California-based Nvidia customers with Chinese ownership.
A fuel tanker crash set off a huge fire on Cairo's ring road, killing at least 31 people.
Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter, says he will petition to delay his execution by firing squad.
Most San Antonio retailers are closed Thanksgiving, with a few grocery stores open.

stories.headline: ❌ Spurs 111, Trail Blazers 116
stories.summary: Final · at Trail Blazers · Record 15-4

stories.headline: What's open in San Antonio on Thanksgiving Day
stories.summary: A handful of grocery stores will open on Thanksgiving, while most retailers will be closed. Stores reopen on Black Friday.
stories.why: Useful for last-minute holiday shopping plans.

stories.headline: Spurs lose first road game 116-111 at Portland
stories.summary: The Blazers beat San Antonio despite Victor Wembanyama's 44 points, handing the Spurs their first road loss. The Lakers visit San Antonio Friday, and Austin Reaves may play.

stories.headline: 92-year-old woman arrested in 1969 Universal City cold case murder of her son
stories.summary: Authorities arrested a 92-year-old woman for murder in her son's 1969 death in Universal City.

stories.headline: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday because of high winds
stories.summary: New York's Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed for the first time in its history. Forecasters expect high winds from a storm on Thursday, so it moves to Saturday.
stories.why: Storms are also disrupting holiday travel for millions.

stories.headline: Fort Hood shooter seeks to delay execution by firing squad
stories.summary: Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at the Texas Army post in 2009, told a federal court he plans to file a petition to delay his execution.

stories.headline: FedEx airplane overruns runway at Miami airport, temporarily closing all but 1 runway
stories.summary: The plane overran a runway after landing at Miami International Airport on Wednesday, and stopped near a fence. FedEx said there were no injuries.

stories.headline: Judge temporarily blocks FCC review of ABC's broadcast licenses
stories.summary: A federal judge stopped the FCC from moving ahead with an early review of ABC's licenses. The network argues the Trump administration is trying to punish speech it dislikes. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.
stories.why: The ruling touches on government pressure over news coverage.

stories.headline: CBS finds U.S.-based firms giving China access to advanced Nvidia chips
stories.summary: A CBS News investigation found at least two California-based Nvidia customers have Chinese ownership, giving China potential access to Nvidia's most advanced technology. It comes as Congress scrutinizes Huang's reinstatement.
stories.why: It raises national security questions about chip export controls.

stories.headline: Court lets Puerto Rico fire company running its power grid
stories.summary: A court ruling nullifies LUMA Energy's contract to run the island's grid, five years after it took over. The government has a year to find a new operator.
stories.why: Puerto Rico's troubled power grid affects the whole island.

stories.headline: Fuel tanker crash causes deadly fire on Cairo highway
stories.summary: A fuel tanker crash ignited a huge fire on Cairo's ring road, killing at least 31 people and injuring at least 21, Egyptian authorities said.

stories.headline: Army to detonate tons of lead azide after delays. And, Abrego Garcia leaves U.S.
stories.summary: Authorities have evacuated a 5-mile radius to prepare to dispose of thousands of pounds of lead azide. And, after a nearly two-year legal battle, Kilmar Abrego Garcia's has voluntarily left the U.S.

stories.headline: Net Migration to U.K. Falls to Lowest Level Since 1997, Excluding Pandemic
stories.summary: Net migration fell in the year ending June 2026, according to the Office for National Statistics The Liberal Democrats are saying the UK needs a proper plan for immigration.

stories.headline: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
stories.summary: The Trump administration has given SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space

stories.headline: The Verge’s 2026 holiday gift guide for travelers
stories.summary: Everyone has that traveler in their life. That person who feels more at home on a 14-hour train ride than a quiet Sunday on the couch. They speak multiple languages, have a gut like a goat, and make friends wherever they go.

stories.headline: A Man in Denver Has Been Throwing Eggs at Waymo Vehicles
stories.summary: The man, who drove a Toyota Corolla from a fleet leased to Lyft drivers, used orange cones to trap the self-driving vehicles before pelting them with eggs, the police said. No charges have been filed.

stories.headline: Europe’s Hera Mission Releases Close-Up Images of the Asteroid Hit by a NASA Spacecraft
stories.summary: A European mission called Hera has just revealed the first close-up look at the aftermath of NASA’s audacious planetary defense test.

stories.headline: Public health specialist discusses the aftermath of the munitions detonation in Iowa
stories.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with public health specialist Will Sander of the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign about the aftermath of the Iowa munitions detonation.

stories.headline: What UK season changes mean for you
stories.summary: Frosts will become less common and hot summer days more frequent in the UK, the Met Office says.

stories.headline: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
stories.summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

stories.headline: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause
stories.summary: Text of the treaties will be published this afternoon, alongside legislation designed to enact the bulk of the deal.

stories.headline: Knee surgery rules Sinner out of Australian Open
stories.summary: Sinner, a two-time champion at Melbourne Park, has not played a match since winning the 2026 Wimbledon title in July.

stories.headline: More ref frustration as Pochettino's chaotic start at Man Utd continues
stories.summary: What are the findings for Mauricio Pochettino after his first two matches as Manchester United manager?

stories.headline: Steelers legend reveals how he tricked the NFL during a 2004 brawl
stories.summary: Former Pittsburgh Steelers linebacker James Farrior shares how he avoided NFL discipline after a 2004 brawl.

stories.headline: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies aged 65
stories.summary: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".

stories.headline: Gordon Ramsay to host Top Gear as show revived after Flintoff crash
stories.summary: The British car show “Top Gear” paused production three years ago and is returning with a new host in 2028, the BBC said.
